remarks: This beautifully renovated 6-bedroom, 5-full and 2-half bath Cape Cod-style home is nestled on 2 private acres, elevated on the property to allow natural light to pour in through expansive windows and French doors.  Located in one of New Canaan's most sought-after cul-de-sacs, the peaceful neighborhood is perfect for leisurely walks and close to NC Land Trust trails. The picturesque grounds boast a heated pool, lush gardens, stone walls and terraces, a fenced yard, and a backup generator, ensuring comfort and security. The new kitchen features a stunning La Cornue range, large island and marble countertops. The home is appointed with custom built-ins and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. The spacious first-floor primary suite offers two walk-in closets, a luxurious marble bath, and serene views of the backyard and  pool. The main floor also features a spacious living room with fireplace and bult-ins, formal dining room, family room with French doors to the backyard, library with built-ins and a guest bedroom with full bath.   Upstairs, you'll find four additional bedrooms, 3 full baths, two cozy sitting rooms, and an upstairs family room. With its ideal blend of privacy, elegance, and comfort, this home is an absolute treasure waiting  for its next lucky owner.
